notes.title: Tavern Doors Are Open! My Asynchronous Auto-Battler Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436398/3eaa972147c951cfdf87cadc451691ff1fcf8e51.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the ​​first official release​​ of my ​​asynchronous auto-battler​​! Every move you make will be matched against saved lineups from real players worldwide — no waiting for matches, no fear of disconnections. Play at your own pace, anytime, anywhere![/p][p]
[b]🎮 ​​Easy to Learn, Deep to Master​​[/b][/p][p]
Pick heroes from the Tavern and place them strategically on the board. When certain heroes stand side-by-side, they trigger powerful ​​Synergy Effects​​ — turning the tide of battle in an instant![/p][p]
[b]🔥 ​​Build Your Own Playstyle​​[/b]
[/p][p]​​Multi-Target Focus:​​ Strike multiple enemies at once for total dominance.
​​AoE Blast Madness:​​ Unleash screen-clearing ultimates for maximum impact.
​​Backline Assassin:​​ Bypass tanks and shred the enemy's core.
​​Eco Rush (ATM Strat):​​ Ramp up resources and overwhelm with economic pressure.
…and many more strategies await your discovery!
[/p][p][b]✨ ​​Crafted with Passion — No AI, Just Hard Work​​[/b]
[/p][p]This demo is the result of ​​600+ days of solo development​​. Every hero is hand-drawn (no AI art), every line of code written through late nights, every asset polished with care.
If you enjoy the gameplay, ​​please join our community and share your thoughts​​ — whether it's a bug, a balance suggestion, or a wild hero idea, your feedback is invaluable and will directly shape the game's future!
[/p][p][b]🚀 ​​Try it now — and let’s build a better version together!​​[/b]
[/p][p]Love,
UncleCheng[/p]
